title: Multi-Continuum Contaminant Transport
objective: Model contaminant movement and transformation to quantify potable-water quality risk.
questions: Which pathways dominate contaminant transfer under coupled flow regimes?
How do reactions and retardation alter risk-relevant concentration patterns?

specialSections.title: ADE Processes
specialSections.body: Resolve advection, dispersion, and diffusion dynamics under heterogeneous flow fields.

specialSections.title: Reactive Transport
specialSections.body: Model reaction pathways that transform concentration, toxicity, and persistence.

specialSections.title: Degradation and Sorption
specialSections.body: Represent degradation kinetics, sorption-retardation, and geochemical attenuation effects.

specialSections.title: Multi-Continuum Transport
specialSections.body: Track contaminant migration and exchange across matrix, macropore, and fracture continua.

specialSections.title: Source Scenarios
specialSections.body: Evaluate transient and event-driven contaminant loading scenarios.

specialSections.title: Water-Quality Outputs
specialSections.body: Produce quality indicators and contaminant-risk products for aquifer and decision modules.

tasks.title: Source Characterization
tasks.summary: Define source-term classes and temporal loading profiles for contaminants.

tasks.title: Reactive Transport Integration
tasks.summary: Integrate advection-dispersion-reaction processes across interacting continua.

tasks.title: Risk Product Generation
tasks.summary: Deliver contaminant flux and quality-risk outputs to WP4 and WP6.

deliverables.title: Quality Risk Maps for Pilot Sites
